community_note.text:
Section 4.7.2(c) of the Galactic Communications Compliance Code does not govern personal social media posts. The GCCC Section 4.7.2(c) pertains specifically to licensed emergency broadcast networks and commercial data relays. Private citizens are not required to file a WEDA-9b under any current statute. [1][2] The Thrrm Administrative Burrow cited here does not have jurisdiction over non-commercial speech acts. [3]

[1] GCCC Annotated Code, Vol. 12, §4.7 (3019 ed.)
[2] Galactic Civil Liberties Tribunal ruling, Prenn v. Thrrm Bureau of Emissions, 3021
[3] GCCC Jurisdictional Scope Declaration, Public Memo 88-C
